title: ParaFusion: A Large-Scale LLM-Driven English Paraphrase Dataset Infused with High-Quality Lexical and Syntactic Diversity
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and linguistic evaluation (lexical and syntactic diversity) of a paraphrase dataset. Although it includes a standard ethics statement and utilizes a moderation endpoint to filter offensive content during the data preparation phase, it does not engage in the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
